text:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] anomaly detected · increased 5xx on model variant alpha-v0.9.3 (p95 latency stable). Error rate jump ~15% over 10m window — routing key: alpha-rollout · investigate please

maya (sre): paging oncall-jordan — can you take this? looks like spike after the 02:10 deploy to alpha. :rotating_light:

oncall-jordan: I’m oncall, looking now. pulling logs and request traces. any customer reports?

sam (support): saw 2 customers with erroring requests, support ticket #54321 opened, customers report truncated responses and 502s. Not widespread yet.

liam (ml-eng): I’m seeing repeated CUDA OOMs and a downstream soft-fail in the transformer kernel on alpha-v0.9.3. Might be a bad quantization tweak in the last build.

maya (sre): ok - plan: 1) soft-suspend new traffic to alpha 2) redirect A/B keys to stable (alpha -> stable-v0.9.1) 3) throttle heavy burst keys 4) engage roll-back of variant if traffic continues.

oncall-jordan: executing soft-suspend now — will keep existing sessions allowed but block new sessions to alpha.

# command
```bash
redwoodctl variant suspend --model alpha-v0.9.3 --mode soft --keep-sessions=true --reason "5xx spike after deploy"
```

incidents-bot: command queued by oncall-jordan · job 67321 · started

incidents-bot: job 67321 completed · result: success · new-traffic-to alpha-v0.9.3 = 0% (existing sessions continued).

liam (ml-eng): good. starting immediate traffic-split change to divert active rollout keys to stable.

# command
```bash
redwoodctl route update --from-variant alpha-v0.9.3 --to-variant stable-v0.9.1 --percent 100 --type gradual --duration 2m
```

incidents-bot: traffic-split job 67322 accepted · routing plan applied: 100% new traffic -> stable-v0.9.1 over 2m window.

maya (sre): applying emergency key-level rate limit for top heavy keys to reduce pressure while we monitor.

# command
```bash
redwoodctl quota update --key-prefix heavy-req- --limit 20rps --window 1s --reason "mitigation alpha spike"
```

incidents-bot: quotas updated for keys matching heavy-req-*.

sam (support): pinging affected customers, escalated to priority. Elsa, sharing templated note?

elsa (cs): sending note now, telling them we diverted traffic to stable and are investigating. link to status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1932001111

liam (ml-eng): I pulled the failing model build artifacts — the quantization pass changed int8 scaling on a head that only manifests with long prefix caching. Reproduced locally with a fuzzed load pattern.

maya (sre): root cause candidate noted. action items: liam to cut a rollback build, jordan to monitor KPIs for 15m, sam/elsa to triage customer tickets, I'll prepare an RCA draft if we keep tracking.

oncall-jordan: KPIs after diversion: 5xx back to baseline within 90s, p95 latency unchanged. continuing monitor for 15m.

incidents-bot: monitoring window started · check-ins every 60s.

liam (ml-eng): preparing rollback artifact (alpha-v0.9.2) and a hotpatch to remove the quantization tweak. Will push for controlled rollout to canary after 20m observation unless errors reappear.

maya (sre): up to you liam — don't rollout until we confirm stable for 15m. If errors resurface we do a full suspend and revert to locked stable image.

sam (support): customers updated, one customer says "thanks for fast switch", others watching logs. no new escalations.

elsa (cs): adding note in the customer tickets referencing the mitigation steps and ETA for follow-up.

oncall-jordan: handing off to maya for next 30m watch while I take the rotation break. maya, please own timeline and updates to channel.

maya (sre): taking handoff. will post updates and escalate to eng lead if we see >2% error rate in next 15m.

incidents-bot: oncall handoff recorded · from oncall-jordan to maya (sre) · at 1932001380.

liam (ml-eng): note for RCA — attach model build diff and kernel logs: s3://redwood-internal/artifacts/alpha/1932/quant-diff.log

maya (sre): current status: mitigation in place (alpha new-traffic suspended, full traffic -> stable), 5xx returned to normal, customer impact limited to <5 customers with short-lived errors. Keeping this thread open for updates and next steps.

incidents-bot: incident state: mitigated · severity lowered to S2 for postmortem. leave thread open for RCA and rollback plan.
